senses.gloss: f. (= h. אָשְׁיָה Jer. L, 15, K’thib אשויה; שוי, cmp. שית) [meshes, layers, v. אַשְׁוָתָא a. אוּרְבָּא,] frame-wall.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 59a:3">Ib. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>תיתרע אשיתאי</he> my framework will be shaken (by the hammering).

<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:16">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ דנפל</he> (read <he>דנפלא</he>; Ms. M. <he>דשא ברייתא</he>) that my wall fell in.—Pl. <cite ref="A03267"><he>אַשְׁיָיתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A03300"><he>אוּשְׁיָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A00921"><he>אוּשָׁיָיתָא</he></cite>, also <cite ref="A03279"><he>אַשְׁוָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A00919"><he>אוּשְׁוָותָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 11:3">Targ. Ps. XI, 3</cite> (h. text <cite ref="U02085"><he>שתות</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:14">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>אשיָתָא וכ׳</he> the walls of his house.
B. Kam. 20ᵇ.—[Not to be confounded with אוּשָּׁא foundation.] V. אַשְׁוָתָא, אַשְׁוָה.
